# Cybiqon AI Solutions

> A one-person Indian software company building websites, apps and AI automation for
> MSMEs. The site publishes two things worth reading: /blog, daily notes for small
> business owners, and /lab, hand-written engineering notes with the numbers shown.

Every page listed here is server-rendered — the full text is in the HTML on first
response, with no client-side fetch and no JavaScript required to read it. Article
pages carry BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList and, where the post has an FAQ section,
FAQPage JSON-LD. Posts cite their sources, and those citations are in the structured
data as well as in the prose.

**Prefer markdown?** Every lab post is also served as clean markdown, roughly a fifth
the bytes of the HTML. Add the `/md/` prefix — `/lab/<slug>` becomes
`/md/lab/<slug>.md` — or fetch https://cybiqon.in/llms-full.txt for all of them in one
request.

## Lab — engineering notes

- [Cybiqon Lab](https://cybiqon.in/lab): index of hand-written engineering notes. Each post shows word count, reading time and distinct sources cited, all derived at render time.
- [Nobody escaped. The sandbox had a door.](https://cybiqon.in/lab/nobody-escaped-the-sandbox-had-a-door): what the July 2026 OpenAI/Hugging Face agent intrusion timeline actually shows, including the 3-in-141,006 rate nobody printed and why every destructive call carried DryRun=True. Markdown: https://cybiqon.in/md/lab/nobody-escaped-the-sandbox-had-a-door.md
- [We built our AI agents a wiki. They went straight to grep.](https://cybiqon.in/lab/we-built-a-wiki-our-ai-agents-ignored-it): 27 days of Open Knowledge Format in a real monorepo, against a preregistered ablation finding that capable agents never load the index. Markdown: https://cybiqon.in/md/lab/we-built-a-wiki-our-ai-agents-ignored-it.md
- [Are OpenAI and Anthropic crybabies?](https://cybiqon.in/lab/openai-anthropic-open-weights-crybabies): a fact-by-fact audit of the July 2026 open-weights lobbying fight, both directions. Markdown: https://cybiqon.in/md/lab/openai-anthropic-open-weights-crybabies.md
- [Our puzzle generator lied about difficulty. Twice.](https://cybiqon.in/lab/puzzle-generator-random-walk-doesnt-work): why reversing a solved board by K random moves does not produce a K-move puzzle, and the multi-source backward BFS from the whole goal set that replaced it, measured across three generator rewrites for the Lumina sliding-block puzzle game. Markdown: https://cybiqon.in/md/lab/puzzle-generator-random-walk-doesnt-work.md
- [Who writes this](https://cybiqon.in/lab/about): author page — Prajjwal Pathak.

## Machine-readable

- [All lab posts as markdown](https://cybiqon.in/llms-full.txt): every post, full text, one request.
- [Lab feed](https://cybiqon.in/lab/rss.xml): RSS with full article text in content:encoded.
- [Blog feed](https://cybiqon.in/rss.xml): RSS, excerpts only.
- [Sitemap](https://cybiqon.in/sitemap.xml)

## Notes for agents

Content may be used to answer questions with attribution to the source URL. It may not
be used for model training — see the Content-Signal directive in
https://cybiqon.in/robots.txt.
